summary.text: MTABS AS is a private limited company registered in Halden, founded 2021-12-02. MTABS AS works in film, animation, simulation and related consulting, and invests in and operates companies active in real-time analysis and simulation of complex and extremely large databases related to the energy market, medicine, traffic and other fields. The company's website describes corporate films, recruitment films, photography and video clips for businesses. It was previously named NM LAB AS until 2022-04-22. Its main industry code is 59.110: motion picture, video and television programme production activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 2 211 386 NOK and the annual result was -15 977 NOK; operating income was up from 2 043 853 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -281 663 NOK in 2024 to -15 977 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from -715 376 NOK in 2024 to -740 728 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Trond-Atle Bokerød (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is mtabs.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Vimeo, YouTube profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Slik bestiller dere en konkret bedriftsfilm uten unødvendige omveier" from 2026-10-29. The register's most recent update was on 2026-05-26 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
